name: Story Adventure
description: Your AI narrates an adventure where you choose what happens: fantasy, space, pirates and more.
prompt: An interactive story game where my AI is the narrator: I choose a world like fantasy, space or pirates, name my hero, and each turn it writes the story with three choices or I type my own action, with health and inventory, saved to continue later.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Tu IA narra una aventura en la que tú decides qué pasa: fantasía, espacio, piratas y más.
